description: This file provides utilities for debugging, reproducing, minifying, and analyzing issues in PyTorch's Dynamo AOT compilation pipeline. It includes functions to generate reproductions of compiler graphs, dump graph states, perform accuracy checks, and run in isolated environments for bug investigation.

methods.name: _CompileFxCallable wrap_compiler_debug( unconfigured_compiler_fn: _CompileFxCallable, compiler_name: str, )
methods.description: Wraps a compiler function to intercept and dump graph states for debugging and reproduction after AOT autograd in PyTorch Dynamo, including handling fake tensors, accuracy checks, and exception handling.

methods.name: str maybe_fbcode_instructions()
methods.description: Returns instructions for running the repro script in Facebook's internal codebase environment if applicable.

methods.name: str generate_compiler_repro_string( gm: torch.fx.GraphModule, args: Sequence[Any], *, stable_output: bool = False, save_dir: Optional[str] = None, stable_hash: bool = False, has_distributed_ops: bool = False, )
methods.description: Generates a Python script string that reproduces a FX graph module's behavior, including model code, dependencies, placeholders, symbolic variables, and kernel configurations.

methods.name: None save_graph_repro( fd: IO[Any], gm: torch.fx.GraphModule, args: Sequence[Any], compiler_name: str, *, stable_output: bool = False, save_dir: Optional[str] = None, command: str = "run", accuracy: Optional[Union[str, bool]] = None, tracing_mode: Optional[str] = None, check_str: Optional[str] = None, stable_hash: bool = False, )
methods.description: Saves a reproduction script to a file, optionally including distributed initializations, and handles distributed operations detection.

methods.name: dump_graph_repro
methods.description: Creates a reproducible Python file representing the FX graph module, including environment setup and execution, for debugging and bug reproduction.

methods.name: None dump_to_minify( gm: torch.fx.GraphModule, args: Sequence[Any], compiler_name: str )
methods.description: Creates a minimal reproduction version of the FX graph module to facilitate debugging of specific bugs.

methods.name: bool isolate_fails( fx_g: torch.fx.GraphModule, args: Sequence[Any], compiler_name: str, env: Optional[dict[str, Any]] = None, save_dir: Optional[str] = None, accuracy: Optional[Union[bool, str]] = None, tracing_mode: Optional[str] = None, check_str: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Runs the generated repro in a separate process to isolate and verify failure cases, useful for debugging flaky or environment-dependent bugs.

methods.name: None repro_minifier_query(options: Any, mod: nn.Module, load_args: Any)
methods.description: Runs the minifier to check if the optimized graph still reproduces the failure, exiting with code 1 if it does.

methods.name: None repro_minify(options: Any, mod: nn.Module, load_args: Any)
methods.description: Performs minification of the FX graph to isolate minimal failure reproductions, with options for offloading, skipping steps, and storing intermediates.

methods.name: None repro_analyze(options: Any, mod: nn.Module, load_args: Any)
methods.description: Performs in-depth analysis of the FX graph and inductor compilation, including intermediate value checks, determinism verification, and divergence detection.

methods.name: tuple[torch.fx.GraphModule,list[Any]] repro_get_args( options: Any, mod: nn.Module, load_args: Any )
methods.description: Returns the FX module and its arguments ready for reproduction, cloning inputs for consistency.

methods.name: None repro_run(options: Any, mod: nn.Module, load_args: Any)
methods.description: Executes the hardened reproduction script, runs the compiled model, and performs accuracy or crash verification.

methods.name: Any run_repro( mod: nn.Module, load_args: Any, *, command: str = "run", accuracy: Union[bool, str] = "", save_dir: Optional[str] = None, tracing_mode: Optional[str] = None, patch_code: Optional[str] = None, check_str: Optional[str] = None, **kwargs: Any, )
methods.description: Main entry point to run a reproduction script with environment setup, argument parsing, and subcommand execution including run, minify, analyze, and get_args.
